steps.title: Configure project build settings and application parameters
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with namespace com.bgtubeplayer.app, target SDK 34, and compile options.

steps.title: Declare foreground media service and permissions in Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with background audio, media playback foreground service type, and notification permissions.

steps.title: Define UI color palette and localized string resources
steps.description: Define YouTube-inspired dark theme colors and app string identifiers in strings.xml and colors.xml.

steps.title: Configure custom Material theme styles
steps.description: Set up material application theme properties in styles.xml.

steps.title: Create shape drawables for UI control buttons
steps.description: Create rounded button background resources for paywall and action controls.

steps.title: Create navigation and media playback vector icons
steps.description: Add back, forward, refresh, home, history, play, pause, and exit vector icons.

steps.title: Implement PaywallManager with thread safety and crash prevention
steps.description: Ensure asynchronous initialization and safe SharedPreferences/Device ID reading without StrictMode or main thread violations.

steps.title: Design main user interface layout with paywall lock overlay
steps.description: Build layout containing top toolbar controls, main WebView frame, error view, and full-screen paywall overlay.

steps.title: Design watch history list and item layouts
steps.description: Build layout for history viewer activity and single history list item.

steps.title: Implement watch history model and SQLite database manager
steps.description: Create HistoryItem data structure and HistoryDbHelper for managing persistent watch history.

steps.title: Implement HistoryAdapter for dynamic list rendering
steps.description: Create custom list adapter with individual item delete listener binding.

steps.title: Fix BackgroundAudioService launch crash and null safety
steps.description: Ensure Notification Channel is created before startForeground, specify API 34 foreground service type, and wrap MediaSession & Audio focus in try-catch blocks.

steps.title: Implement Watch History Activity
steps.description: Build HistoryActivity to display logged watch history, open selected URLs, and support clearing logs.

steps.title: Safe service startup and background playback bridge in MainActivity
steps.description: Wrap startForegroundService and service binding in exception handlers to prevent launch crashes on boot.

steps.description: Compile final APK package for BG Tube Player.
